answer: Trust flows only through a vouching graph seeded by audited founders, spreading at most three hops the way cargo leaves one harbor. Each vouch locks 200 POA for 120 days and is slashed if the vouchee is caught duplicating work. A farm of 5,000 sybils vouching for each other forms a closed cluster with near-zero incoming flow, however tall its internal summit of edges. Buying 500 honest outside vouches risks 100,000 POA. Like saffron, real edges are scarce. Caveat: founders must be diverse.
